import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class NativeCaseFixture {
  @Test
  void firstRealmCase() {
    assertThat(root.path("input").path("context").get("realm").asText())
        .isEqualTo("realm-a");
  }

  @Test
  void unrelatedCase() {
    assertThat(root.path("input").path("action").asText()).isEqualTo("GET_CATALOG");
  }

  @Test
  void secondRealmCase() {
    assertThat(context.path("realm").asText()).isEqualTo("realm-b");
  }
}
